changelog: v0.8.3: 1) Dedicated Ambient Music Controller: Transformed the top bar music icon into a dedicated soundscape manager modal allowing play/pause toggle, track selection across all 8 soundscapes, previous/next skipping, volume slider, and automotive repeat; 2) Universal Floating Tooltips: Added interactive floating helper tooltips on hover across all toolbar icons, buttons, and settings; 3) Compact Gestures Combo Box: Replaced the expansive gesture button row with a sleek, compact dropdown select control and quick freestyle toggle; 4) Pure Immersive View: Refined avatar-free immersive view keeping the full 360 space environment active without black screen; 5) Quest 3 Left Stick & Android Touch Locomotion: Smooth avatar walking with dynamic heading orientation.
